gaps.sentence: They made me ___ for the whole team's mistake.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive in active sentences: made me apologise.

gaps.sentence: The scheme aims ___ younger visitors to the museum.
gaps.explanation: aim + to-infinitive: aims to attract (aim at + -ing is also possible in BrE).

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
I'm learning ___ the guitar at the moment.
gaps.explanation: learn takes the to-infinitive (learn how to play).
happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: The children are looking forward to ___ Father Christmas.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: looking forward to meeting.

gaps.sentence: It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the fence between the two gardens.
gaps.explanation: agree takes the to-infinitive: agreed to mend.
